facts.fact: Adwave's article states that in-depth analysis of millions of profiles shows the primary Google Business Profile category is the #1 ranking factor for getting into the Local Pack (source of the analysis not named).
facts.quote: In-depth analysis of millions of profiles shows that the primary category is the #1 ranking factor for getting into the Local Pack.

facts.fact: Adwave states that Google's predefined list of business categories contains over 4,000 options, which appear as suggestions in the GBP dashboard.
facts.quote: suggestions from its predefined list of over **4,000** categories.

facts.fact: Adwave recommends reviewing the top 3-5 businesses in local Google Maps results for a service search to see which category they use.
facts.quote: Take a look at the top **3-5** businesses that pop up in the local map results.

facts.fact: Adwave recommends choosing a small number of additional GBP categories, usually 2-3, that represent other major services offered.
facts.quote: Your goal is to choose a small, powerful handful, usually just **2-3**, that represent other major services you offer.

facts.fact: Adwave's article was published on March 5, 2026.
Adwave's article states that over 4,000 Google Business Profile categories are now available.
facts.quote: With over **4,000** categories now available, Google also unlocks unique profile features based on your choices

facts.fact: Adwave's article states that Google allows businesses to add up to nine additional categories to a Google Business Profile.
facts.quote: While Google lets you add up to nine additional categories, doing so is one of the worst things you can do.

facts.fact: Adwave recommends limiting a Google Business Profile to a maximum of 1-2 additional categories.
facts.quote: Stick to a maximum of **1-2 additional categories** that represent other core, profitable services you offer.

facts.fact: Adwave recommends reviewing Google Business Profile categories at least twice a year.
facts.quote: Make it a habit to review your categories at least twice a year and any time you add or remove a major service.

facts.fact: Adwave's guidance recommends reviewing Google Business Profile categories at least twice a year and anytime a major change is made to services.
facts.quote: give them a quick review at least **twice a year** and _anytime_ you make a major change to your services.

facts.fact: According to Adwave, Google's category list is now over 4,000 options long.
facts.quote: it’s now over **4,000** options long and gets updated all the time.

facts.fact: Adwave states that Google lets businesses add up to nine additional categories to a Google Business Profile.
facts.quote: Google lets you add up to nine additional categories

facts.fact: Adwave recommends that businesses use 2-4 additional GBP categories at most.
facts.quote: You should aim for **2-4 additional categories, tops**.

facts.fact: Adwave advises that changing a primary Google Business Profile category can cause a temporary dip or fluctuation in local rankings.
facts.quote: swapping your primary category **can cause a temporary dip or fluctuation in your local rankings**.

facts.fact: Adwave's guidance is that frequent category changes can look spammy to Google and might trigger re-verification or suspension.
facts.quote: Frequent changes can look spammy to Google and might even trigger a re-verification or suspension.
